agent.IncompleteResponseError: Raise "Max. tokens" under "Advanced" for this agent, or ask for a shorter answer in its task.
agent.OutputLimitReached: Raise "Max. tokens" under "Advanced" for this agent, or ask for a shorter answer in its task.
agent.ReasoningLimitReached: Increase “Max. tokens” under “Advanced” for the agent, or lower its effort.
agent.ContextWindowExceeded: Shorten the input or the agent's knowledge, or choose a model with a larger context window.
agent.RefusalError: Check the task and the input and describe the job more clearly. Some content a model always declines.
agent.MaxToolRoundsError: Raise "Max. tool rounds" under "Advanced" for this agent, or say in its task when it is done.
agent.MaxToolRoundsLoop: Describe in the task when the agent is done, or choose a larger model. More tool rounds rarely help here.
agent.StructuredOutputError: Check the fields under "Output format"; a few clearly described fields help. Often continuing the run is enough.
agent.UnexpectedResponseError: Continue the run. If it happens again, the technical details help the provider's support.
agent.HistoryConversionError: If the agent was switched to a model of another provider, continue with the earlier model. Otherwise the technical details name the message for a bug report.
agent.EvaluationFailedError: Read the check's reasoning at the step and adjust the task or the criteria.
agent.ToolExecutionError: The technical details name the tool and its error. Check the tool under "Tools".
agent.MaxToolCallsError: Give this agent fewer tools per step, or split its task so that one answer needs fewer calls.
agent.VectorError: If the embedding model was changed, choose it under Knowledge search and rebuild the index. Otherwise try another embedding model.

run.provider_rejected_messages: Continue the run: steps that already succeeded are not repeated. If it happens again, the technical details list the conversation's messages (without their content) for a bug report.
